thread:
Maya Chen: Opening a small docs PR to tighten SOC2 language and add a short audit-log retention guide + SDK snippets. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/912

Oliver G.: Thanks. Legal asked to avoid active voice like 'we retain'. Use 'admins can configure' or passive phrasing.

Maya Chen: Reworded intro to neutral phrasing and added a one-paragraph "how retention is configured" note.

infra-team: Note: API path changed in prod -> /v1/admin/audit-logs (previously /v1/auditlogs). Update examples.

Maya Chen: Updated all examples to use /v1/admin/audit-logs and added a tiny migration checklist for Dedicated customers (verify endpoints, rotate keys, check webhooks).

Oliver G.: Can you include a minimal Python SDK snippet and a curl line for SRE smoke tests? Keep it short.

Maya Chen: Draft snippets:
```python
# list audit logs (admin)
client.admin.audit_logs.list(start_time='2025-04-01T00:00:00Z', limit=100)
```
Curl smoke test: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/audit-logs?page=1"`

legal-bot: Auto-scan: flagged phrase "we keep logs" in one paragraph. Suggest: "Audit logs may be retained per admin-configured policies; legal/regulatory obligations may supersede these settings." Also lint: missing code-block language on the Python snippet.

Maya Chen: Fixed flagged phrase and added python fence. Marked PR ready-for-review and assigned to @Oliver G. for legal pass. :white_check_mark:
